appearance_facts.fact: The chart is titled 'Incidence of Condition A in US States'.
It is a choropleth map of the United States.
States are colored in a gradient from light yellow to dark red.
The legend on the right is labeled 'High' at the top and 'Low' at the bottom.
The legend uses a color scale with numerical markers: 100 (dark red), 80, 60, 40, 20, and 0 (light yellow).
California (CA) is colored dark red, indicating the highest incidence value.
Tennessee (TN) is colored light yellow, indicating the lowest incidence value.
Delaware (DE) is colored a medium orange-red, indicating a moderate incidence value.

printed_facts.fact: The legend's top value is 100, corresponding to the darkest red color.
The legend's bottom value is 0, corresponding to the lightest yellow color.
California (CA) is the only state colored dark red, matching the 100 value on the legend.
Tennessee (TN) is the only state colored light yellow, matching the 0 value on the legend.
Delaware (DE) is colored a shade of orange-red, positioned between 40 and 60 on the legend scale.
